items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Alvin Burroughs was with Walter but he left to go with George E Lee... nobody had a sock cymbal but Alvin Burroughs.

ctx.x: He left Walter Page's band, or Bennie Moten's band? Who did Alvin Burroughs leave?

Alvin Burroughs was with Walter but he left to go with George E. Lee because George E. Lee was up North now. I mean, he's in the Midwest, he's in Minnesota, and what have you, and George E. Lee said, I'm sorry, I mean we've going with economics now.
He's a bandleader, he had a great band.
